notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31035706/6a71a837369f845d36d08c08cfb1072a555b83cb.jpg[/img]Happy New Year to our Chinese friends!

Greetings,

Today we have patched our High Mountain Roller Coaster VR to 1.1. We believe that with these fixes the roller coaster ride should be more pleasant and less glitchy.

Right, so we are going to continue on optimizing our game - feel free to let us know if you are still experiencing some issues. We will do what we can to solve them as soon as possible.

Until next time!

notes.title: Merry Christmas!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31035706/d4722b6eed17fdb6738eceea78e9038b8015cc4d.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

We're in the midst of patching our beloved game up, but since it is this time of the year we would like to wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

We hope that 2018 is going to be just as exciting as 2017.
See you on top of the mountain!

notes.title: A Short Announcement!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31035706/6a71a837369f845d36d08c08cfb1072a555b83cb.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,

Thank you for your support through our launch day and beyond. We're aware that there are some bugs that we need to get rid of, so don't worry, we are on it!

A patch is being made and it should hit Steam in about 1-2 weeks. What will be fixed? You'll know with the patch.

High Mountain Roller Coaster VR is still being developed - we are not going anywhere! We hope we will be able to deliver the patch as soon as possible.

Thank you for your continuous support!
